description:
The studio's own settings, in the OS user config dir (`settings.json`).

Paths are absolute, as the user's OS spells them. They are remembered, not trusted: opening one
goes through the same checks as a path the user just picked.

currentWorkspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace opened last, or null before the first one.

recentWorkspaces.description: Absolute paths of recently opened workspaces, most recent first, at most 10, without duplicates.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the app settings format. This schema describes version 1.

title: AppSettings
